body.p: When the AI needs more details before it can carry on, it asks you instead of guessing. The questions appear in the conversation, each with a set of suggested answers, and the AI waits for your reply before going any further.

Choose one of the suggested answers, or select Other... and type your own. A question that accepts more than one answer at a time shows its answers as check boxes rather than radio buttons. Nothing is final until you select Continue, which becomes available once every question has an answer. You can also answer by typing in the chat input box, in which case what you type answers the first question still waiting for one.
If you would rather not answer, select Skip. The AI is told that you declined, decides on its own, and carries on.
The whole box can be used from the keyboard: the arrow keys move between the answers, Enter continues, and Esc skips.
The questions and the answers you gave stay part of the conversation, so they are shown again if you reopen it later from the history.
